name: Interior Door Slab NC - QT4 Premium, Spray, Factory Primed
_demonstration_note: Same module list as SCN_DOOR_SLAB_NC_QT3_SPRAY_FROM_BARE — including MOD_DOOR_PRIME — but the prime module's tasks gate by substrate_condition=bare_wood. With substrate_condition=factory_primed in the ctx, both prime tasks SKIP via task-level applies_when. The prime module fires (its applies_when at module level is empty) but produces zero hours because both its tasks are gated. This is the same state-branching mechanism the trim demo proved, applied to doors.
